# Traders
Every city has a camp of shadow traders, where they offer their goods.
## Day and night cycle
Traders work according to the time of day: at dawn they emerge from the rift and lay out their goods. At sunset they pack up the shop and leave until the next dawn. This rotates the goods on sale, even if players don't buy anything.
## Orders
Besides selling goods, traders give you a way to earn money: they have a special area where they post requests for resources and pay coins in return.
## Currency There are 4 types of coins in the game, each of a different denomination.
1 silver coin = 10 copper coins 1 gold coin = 10 silver coins 1 platinum coin = 10 gold coins
